abstract_sentences.text: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, balancing helpfulness and safety has become a central challenge.

evidence.anchor: balancing helpfulness and safety has become a central challenge

abstract_sentences.text: A natural approach is to incorporate safety constraints into Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), where recent studies have shown promising progress.

evidence.anchor: incorporate safety constraints into Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

abstract_sentences.text: However, these methods often rely on auxiliary networks or multi-stage pipelines, thereby increasing complexity.

evidence.anchor: auxiliary networks or multi-stage pipelines

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we revisit the original safety alignment objective and show that, under mild assumptions, it admits a closed-form optimal policy.

evidence.anchor: under mild assumptions, it admits a closed-form optimal policy

abstract_sentences.text: We further derive a provably equivalent and tractable objective, enabling direct optimization.

evidence.anchor: provably equivalent and tractable objective

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this insight, we propose SafeDPO, a lightweight method that preserves the optimal solution of the underlying safety-constrained objective while requiring only one additional hyperparameter and minimal modifications to existing preference-based training methods.

evidence.anchor: only one additional hyperparameter and minimal modifications

abstract_sentences.text: SafeDPO eliminates the need for reward models, cost models, and online sampling, relying only on preference data and safety indicators.

evidence.anchor: relying only on preference data and safety indicators

abstract_sentences.text: Despite its simplicity, SafeDPO achieves competitive safety-helpfulness trade-offs compared to existing safety alignment methods.

evidence.anchor: competitive safety-helpfulness trade-offs

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on the PKU-SafeRLHF-30K benchmark demonstrate that SafeDPO substantially improves safety while maintaining competitive helpfulness.

evidence.anchor: substantially improves safety while maintaining competitive helpfulness

abstract_sentences.text: Ablation studies further show that the additional hyperparameter provides a flexible mechanism to enhance safety while preserving the theoretical optimum, and confirm that SafeDPO scales reliably to LLMs with up to 13B parameters.

evidence.anchor: scales reliably to LLMs with up to 13B parameters

abstract_sentences.text: Overall, our results highlight that a simple, theory-driven objective can provide a lightweight yet effective solution for safety alignment in practice.

evidence.anchor: theory-driven objective can provide a lightweight yet effective solution

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文以 hard safety constraint 为起点：用 r_c=-infinity 得到 unsafe support 为零的 KL 闭式策略，再以 T(D) 将 latent preference 改写成可训练 pair，最后用一个 Delta 放大 safe–unsafe 梯度；Figure 2/3、XSTest 与附录评测共同显示更严格安全伴随保守性与 evaluator coupling。（p.4–10，§3–5）
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 hard/expected constraint、r_c、闭式 policy、T 的三分支、margin 语义、Prop.4.2–4.4 陈述、Figure 2/3、Table 1–3、共同 SFT/基线/评测定义和 XSTest trade-off；这些足以理解方法选择，但不能复核证明、模板、seed 和 evaluator counterevidence。（p.3–10）
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明/梯度在 A，资源/超参数/提示词在 B，额外 baseline/消融/尺度/效率/数值在 C，GPT 模板与案例在 D，失败分析在 E；迁移保留正文可扫读性，却把 theory notation gap、judge coupling、over-refusal 机制和分母缺口推迟到附录。（p.13–40）
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的写作与方法模式是 hard constraint semantics → -infinity reward → support-zero closed form → 三分支数据变换；Figure 1/2/3 分别承载组件差异、双 evaluator 结果和 Delta 变化，形成方法–预测–结果链。（p.2、p.4–8）
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是 Prop.4.2 混用无 C 的 Eq.8 与有限 C 的 Eq.13，Prop.4.3 未形式化 latent D-tilde 与经验 D 的生成一致性，Table 12 的 798 与约 3,000 test entries 未对齐；此外 100% harmless ratio 与 12.4% over-refusal 不等同于语境敏感的实用安全。（p.4、p.6、p.7、p.10、p.13–16、p.26、p.38–40）
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 声称 hard safety guarantee 时，应前置 safe-support 与 bounded-reward 条件，分开 global optimum 和 finite training，并用 independent evaluator、人评、safe–safe 控制和 benign over-refusal 同时评测 strict safety 与语境帮助性。（p.6、p.13、p.16–17、p.31、p.38–40）
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于可靠二值安全标签、safe set 在 pi_ref 下有正质量、reward 可界定且 response support 可被 hard mask 的离线 preference training；不自动适用于连续/不完备 cost、需要语境推理的边界、更大未知模型或未经独立校准的 judge。（p.6、p.13、p.10、p.38–40）
